question: Which eight NER tasks did they evaluate on?

answer.free_form_answer: BC5CDR-disease, NCBI-disease, BC5CDR-chem, BC4CHEMD, BC2GM, JNLPBA, LINNAEUS, Species-800
BC5CDR-disease, NCBI-disease, BC5CDR-chem, BC4CHEMD, BC2GM, JNLPBA, LINNAEUS, Species-800

title: Inexpensive Domain Adaptation of Pretrained Language Models: A Case Study on Biomedical Named Entity Recognition
answer_short: eight publicly available NER tasks used in BIBREF2
answer_rationale: Text 1 explicitly states that they finetune GreenBioBERT on 'the eight publicly available NER tasks used in BIBREF2'. Text 7 corroborates this by mentioning evaluation on 'eight biomedical Named Entity Recognition (NER) tasks' and comparing against BioBERT, referencing BIBREF2 as the source of these tasks.
